name: opinion-manager
description: Choose template variants and exact versions; manage personal Profiles, locked snapshots and upgrade previews.

interface.shortDescription: Generate, compose, review and maintain Agent behavior rules
interface.longDescription: Offers approved, selectable rules and templates. Three main entry points: use a template as is, pick some of its items, or start from blank; candidates can also be proposed from authorized memory. The full content is confirmed once, and each fingerprint is verified by the tool; supports immutable versions, personal Profiles, locks and upgrade protection. Public content still needs the user's file-by-file approval. 中文：提供经过批准的可选规则与模板；三个主入口为直接用模板、选择部分条目、从空白开始，另可基于已授权记忆提出候选。完整内容集中确认，工具分别核验指纹；支持不可变版本、个人 Profile、锁和升级保护。公开内容仍需用户逐文件批准。
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $opinion-manager to generate or maintain OPINION.md for this environment.
